verdict.rationale: Adyen documents that the payment response and webhooks can include risk information, including which risk rules triggered. That gives analysts some reasons behind a risk decision rather than only a bare score. However, nothing shows that the machine-learning score itself comes with ranked top risk factors or feature-level explanations. Missing for 10: per-score top-factor or feature-attribution explanations for ML scores, evidence that reasons are surfaced for every score in the analyst UI, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, every score comes with its top risk factors — why this transaction looks risky — not just an opaque number

citations.quote: You can include risk information, such as whether a payment was sent to case management, and which risk rules triggered in these webhooks, as well as in the payment response.
